scope: One synthetic one-page AcroForm PDF opened by the isolated Seafile/PdfCraft route.
fixture_setup: The synthetic fixture was uploaded before editing; that setup upload is not the editor save.
edit: A unique alphanumeric value was typed through Chromium into the existing PDF name field. The editor showed unsaved changes before Ctrl+S.
save: The editor POST payload contained the field value; the host confirmed save; Seafile History gained a version attributed by the test to the synthetic test user.
readback: The PDF downloaded from Seafile contains the field value. Its bytes equal the captured relay save payload (2,386 bytes; SHA-256 d1bb31792966cf0b5551029e56224074629e2590c9a6865be92ce70d6599dad2). The retained PDF matches those bytes.
fresh_session: A new browser context authenticated separately and opened the same synthetic file through its explicit ?edit_pdf=true route. /relay/file bytes equaled Seafile readback and the field value remained present.
downloads: The browser observed no file download during the editor save flow.
navigation_limit: The fresh PDF editor was opened by direct Seafile file route with ?edit_pdf=true because the ordinary Seafile PDF list link opens preview; this run does not claim a file-list click into PdfCraft.
not_verified: broad PDF fidelity or complete external PDF validity
pdf_tool_diagnostic: pdftotext extracted the saved field value but emitted three 'Bad form bounding box' warnings; full external PDF validity is not claimed.
runtime_run: Final fresh database run after GPT R1 remediation; HTTP completed before focused Chromium.
revisions_assertion: The PDF field check resolves active objects through the classic xref revision chain; the offline regression rejects a superseded incremental field value.
post_run_helper_fix: GPT R2 found an EOF no-progress loop in malformed xref handling. An EOF guard and regression were added after runtime run 7; successful-run behavior on the valid saved PDF was not rerun for this malformed-input-only helper change.
